title: Stroke Treatment
ischemic_stroke: Alteplase (IV r-tPA): A clot-dissolving medicine. Must be given within 4.5 hours of symptom onset.
Endovascular Procedures: Doctors may remove the clot directly from the blocked blood vessel in the brain.
hemorrhagic_stroke: Controlling bleeding and reducing pressure in the brain.
Surgery may be required to repair blood vessel abnormalities like aneurysms.
